name: larix decidua resin + pineapple + silicon dioxide
purpose: Use: Temporary relief of dry skin around the eyes.
otcwarn: Warnings: Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated. Contains sugar. Diabetics and persons intolerant of sucrose (sugar): Consult a doctor before use. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a doctor before use for serious conditions or if conditions worsen or persist. If pregnant or nursing, consult a doctor before use. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing.
